notes.title: Update v2.1.0
notes.content:
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/778484758096906668/04831C9D5A2C01E04F66A1AB572C6416B87DD4E0/[/img]
Update v2.1.0

[b]Main[/b]
Upgraded to Unity 2019.2
Increased shadow distance in all quality levels
Added new Lowest quality setting
Added shadow cascades to options
Improved Image effect quality
Fixed music playing at start
Added option to set Target Frame-rate, v-Sync will need to be Deactivated for it to work!
Added new Player footstep sounds
Removed unnecessary Shader keywords from Dissolve Shader
Added AI Spawner to Flat Grounds map
Remade Main Menu UI
Fixed Hover over UI event from not setting defaults after exit
Removed confusing and not needed loading screen
Set reporting debug info to off
Fixed very very hard mode not showing as an option to difficulty
Other bug fixes and improvements

[b]AI[/b]
Fixed several AI movements
Big improvements to AI
Removed random health for AI
 Fixed AI spawning in the ocean on survival island
Reworked AI attack ranges
Added new AI footstep sounds
New Alien-Assassin AI Animations and Model
Added extra attack animations to Titan AI

Game-Modes
Survival Island is now 4x bigger
Improved survival island vegetation
Survival island generation nodes have been improved
Survival Island saves have been wiped as they will not be compatible with the new map
Removed zombie island from Survival Island
Lowered the crafting cost of several items, for survival mode
Fixed Shadows on Building in Survival Mode
Fixed Footsteps not playing on some Building parts in Survival Mode
Added Sand Box Mode
Added Flat Grounds Map for Sand Box Mode
Fixed Placing and Destroying Building Parts sound FX
New Build Part preview Shader, for place and can't place

[b]Weapon Changes[/b]
Fixed RPG clipping
Fixed save bug with ADS Zooming
Camera will follow player in 3rd person mode [Hold Left Alt to rotate camera]
Fixed Explosions FX, removed heat distortion as it was blocking everything
Removed damage based on range, (these changes are designed to speed up gameplay and are subject to change)
Reworked damage amount on most weapons
Added survival tools to test range
Fixed Steel Axe and Hammer not showing the mesh model in third person mode
Fixed bug being able to have infinite C4
New Revolver Fire sound
Fixed Deagle Fire sound was set to half volume

[b]Environment[/b]
Sky clouds and fog are much better
Added Aurora to sky
Split up terrains on all maps
New water and underwater fog Shaders
Reworked vegetation on several maps
Increased vegetation spawn range across quality settings

notes.title: RWS v2.0 Alpha Test 3
notes.content:
Hi, I updated the Alpha Branch with the latest version of the Testing Demo for RWS v2.0. RWS v2.0 will be a FREE update to RWS, and is being rebuilt from the ground up.

[IMG]http://i66.tinypic.com/300tzbs.jpg[/IMG]

Includes massive upgrades like, Headshots, New Hitboxes, Bow and Arrows, Sword & Shield (Riot Shield & Pistol is being made), Grenades, Free Aim/Zooming, Third Person View (not fully animated), Command-able Ai & More...

RWS main game-mode will be an open world Survival, where you can build, craft and survive. Will also include game modes like Wave Survival, and Ai Battles. 

[IMG]http://i67.tinypic.com/hx59b9.jpg[/IMG]

New Weapons added more being added, all weapons have the correct name now. The Assault Rifle has been replaced with a AK47. Some weapons are dupes as they are placeholders for new weapons.

[IMG]http://i65.tinypic.com/fn4bag.jpg[/IMG]

** Press ESC, and goto Player Settings to unlock all weopons

** Use F to command Ai, you can make them follow you, you can send them to a location and tell them to stay.

** To pickup Objects hold F key and left-click on mouse to throw.

** Hold G to throw grenades while holding another weapon, you can also select the Grenade to hold in your hand

** The Buggy is back, and now deal damage to Ai, also has no FPS drops

** Headshots in the demo are set to 10x, but will prob be around 2x when release.

** Only a few Ai have had the HP set, most are set to 100HP.

Plus loads more adjustments :D

Thank You & Enjoy :D

.........................................
How?
1. Right-click RWS from Steam Library
2. Click Properties, then choose Betas tab
3. Click Opt-into Beta, and choose Alpha from the list
4. Steam will Download

5. Right-click RWS from Steam Library
6. Choose Play Alpha 

7. Have Fun!
8. Please give suggestions or report bugs to help me fix before release :D

[IMG]http://i64.tinypic.com/dfg9pt.jpg[/IMG]

[IMG]http://i68.tinypic.com/vmx3r5.png[/IMG]

To Access the Alpha version; 
1; Right- click on Resilience from your Game library

4; From the drop down list, select Beta 
5; Steam will download the Alpha Version 

To Play the Alpha; 
1; While in the Properties menu
2; Click on the Local Files tab
3; Click Browse Local Files
4; Double-click the RWS DEV.exe file (32bit Version is labeled RWS DEV32.exe)
